bugsFound.fix: Removed redundant activeCounts increment inside queued waiter resolve callback in ResourceLimiter.
bugsFound.rootCause: When a permit was released to a waiting queue candidate, release() transferred the permit without decrementing activeCounts, but waiter.resolve() simultaneously incremented activeCounts + 1.
bugsFound.symptom: Double-increment in ResourceLimiter activeCounts during queued permit resolution.

bugsFound.fix: Initialized candidateIndex to -1 in BackpressureQueue.processNext and added bounds check to prevent dequeuing uneligible jobs when all queued jobs belong to saturated users/tenants.
bugsFound.rootCause: candidateIndex defaulted to 0 instead of -1 during fair candidate search.
bugsFound.symptom: Queued jobs for saturated users/orgs were dequeued prematurely when global capacity was available.

bugsFound.fix: Registered signal.addEventListener('abort') with immediate wait-queue splice and rejection in ResourceLimiter.
bugsFound.rootCause: ResourceLimiter did not listen to AbortSignal during queue wait.
bugsFound.symptom: Resource permit waiters leaked indefinitely when client requests were cancelled while waiting.
